pages.text: Offer a Silver Ingot, one Poppy, Ectoplasm and a Spider Eye in a small white circle. The ritual must begin during daytime in the Overworld. Poppy is required here; the original recipe used the default red-flower variant.

After five seconds, time advances to the next legacy moon target, day tick 17,600. The cost is 250 startup plus five payments of 20: 350 total, or 312 while wearing Hecate's Visage. There is no item output.
Black Dogs now provide Ectoplasm through ordinary drops and Athame harvesting. It changes time for everyone in the world; a natural sunset during casting does not cancel it.
